title: Soyaltepec Mixtec - Wikipedia
text: Soyaltepec Mixtec is a moribund Mixtec language of Oaxaca spoken in the villages of San Bartolo Soyaltepec and Guadalupe Gabilera. It is not close to other varieties of Mixtec.

text: Primarily associated with the villages of San Bartolo Soyaltepec, Guadalupe Gabilera, and nearby communities, it is classified under the Northeastern Alta Mixtec subgroup within the broader Mixtecan branch.

title: Mixtec, Soyaltepec Language (VMQ) – L1 & L2 ... - Ethnologue
text: Soyaltepec Mixtec is an endangered indigenous language of Mexico. It belongs to the Otomanguean language family. The language is used as a first language by all adults in the ethnic community, but not all young people. It is not known to be taught in schools.
